database_fields.route_description: Printed opening chain supports Ibn Abbas's good-given gloss.
database_fields.source_citation_text: ثُمَّ قَالَ الْبُخَارِيُّ: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيم، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْكَوْثَرِ: هُوَ الْخَيْرُ الَّذِي أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ إِيَّاهُ. قَالَ أَبُو بِشْرٍ: قُلْتُ لِسَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ: فَإِنَّ نَاسًا يَزْعُمون أَنَّهُ نَهْرٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ؟ فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ: النَّهْرُ الَّذِي فِي الْجَنَّةِ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ الَّذِي أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ إِيَّاهُ.

database_fields.route_description: First coordinated branch of the abundant-good gloss. The anaphoric reporting context does not supply an unprinted upstream chain.
database_fields.source_citation_text: وَرَوَاهُ أَيْضًا مِنْ حَدِيثِ هُشَيْمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ وَعَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ: الْكَوْثَرُ: الْخَيْرُ الْكَثِيرُ.

decisions: R1 is projected twice because evidence_units has distinct gloss and reply units; duplicate report context is not independent evidence.
R2 becomes two parallel route rows, never one serial chain through both Abu Bishr and Ata.
Only R1-reply attaches to E3; all later abundant-good routes attach to E2.
source_citation_text preserves the full exact context while route_description distinguishes scoped support.
Symbolic evidence_unit_ref resolves to physical evidence_unit_id; staging metadata is not inserted as columns.
Route IDs are not invented. Identity generation/defaults and authorized insertion workflow must be verified before publication.
explicit_limits: No schema migrations or database writes.
This projection is not merged into the provisional draft or assembly.
No external source verification or narrator grading performed.
No claim of route independence; repeated projections must not increase witness counts.
next_step: Add repeatable projection validator, verify route identity generation and then merge validated routes into a revised isolated candidate.
